newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar eases vs yen after Japan auto body remarks.
newsitem.headline: Dollar eases vs yen after Japan auto body remarks.

text.p: *Dollar eases slightly towards 118.00 yen in afternoon Tokyo on long liquidation sales partly in reaction to comments by Takao Tominaga, vice chairman and executive managing director of the Japan Automobile Manufacturers' Association (JAMA), that he does not want to see the dollar strengthening from the current level.
*"Traders took his comments as a good excuse to unload dollar-long positions... But I don't think it will change the recent uptrend of the dollar," a city bank dealer said.
